# AAUW

> AAUW empowers women through research, advocacy, fellowships, and programs addressing gender equity in education, economic security, and civil rights.

AAUW (American Association of University Women) is a 170,000-member organization founded in 1881 dedicated to advancing gender equity and women's empowerment. The organization combines data-driven research with grassroots advocacy and direct support programs including fellowships, salary negotiation training, and financial literacy workshops.

## Key Topics

- Gender Equity
- Title IX
- STEM Education
- Gender Pay Gap
- Women's Economic Empowerment
- Policy Advocacy
- Fellowships & Grants
- Salary Negotiation
- Financial Literacy
- Civil Rights
- Higher Education
- Career Development
- Research & Data
- UN Women Partnerships
- Equal Pay

## About & Mission

- [About AAUW](https://www.aauw.org/about): AAUW mission, values, and organizational information for the 170,000-member organization
- [Membership](https://www.aauw.org/membership): AAUW membership overview, benefits, Community Hub, and member resources

## Core Advocacy Issues

- [Explore the Issues](https://www.aauw.org/issues): Core advocacy issues including gender equity, education, economic security, and leadership
- [Education Equity](https://www.aauw.org/issues/education): Education equity advocacy addressing Title IX, student debt, and women's educational access
- [Economic Security](https://www.aauw.org/issues/economic-security): Economic security focus on gender pay gap, equal pay, and workplace equity
- [The Gender Pay Gap](https://www.aauw.org/issues/economic-security/pay-gap): Research and analysis on persistent gender pay gap and wage inequality
- [Social Justice & Civil Rights](https://www.aauw.org/issues/civil-rights): Civil rights advocacy including Equal Rights Amendment and violence against women
- [The STEM Gap](https://www.aauw.org/issues/education/stem): STEM gap advocacy addressing women underrepresentation in science and technology
- [Global Connections](https://www.aauw.org/issues/civil-rights/global-connections): International partnerships with UN Women and global women empowerment initiatives

## Fellowships, Grants & Financial Support

- [Fellowships & Grants](https://www.aauw.org/resources/programs/fellowships-grants): AAUW fellowship and grant programs for women's graduate education and career development
- [Donation Opportunities](https://my.aauw.org/donation-product-detail): Donation funds and giving opportunities including Greatest Needs and Higher Education Funds

## Women Empowerment Programs

- [Get Empowered](https://www.aauw.org/get-empowered): Women empowerment programs: Work Smart, Start Smart, Money Smart salary and financial literacy
- [Work Smart & Start Smart: Salary Negotiation](https://www.aauw.org/resources/programs/salary-negotiation): Salary negotiation workshops and training for women's economic empowerment
- [AAUW Money Smart](https://www.aauw.org/resources/programs/money-smart): Free virtual financial literacy workshops on money management and wealth building

## Research, Policy & Action

- [Research & Data](https://www.aauw.org/research): AAUW research reports on gender pay gap, STEM, student debt, and women's leadership
- [Policy Center](https://www.aauw.org/act/policy-center): Policy advocacy and legislative action on pay equity, Title IX, and gender equity
- [Take Action](https://www.aauw.org/act): Advocacy and action opportunities for women's rights, education equity, and policy change

## News & Updates

- [News](https://www.aauw.org/resources/news/media): Press releases, AAUW Insights, and news coverage of organizational initiatives

## Optional

- [Member Portal Login](https://my.aauw.org/NC__Login): Member portal login and authentication for Community Hub access
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.aauw.org/privacy-policy): Privacy policy covering data collection, cookies, and user information management
